canonical_name: No Clear Desk and Clear Screen Policy
description: Clear desk and clear screen rules for papers and removable storage media are not defined and enforced.
applicability: Organizations where personnel handle sensitive information in physical form or on computer screens that could be viewed by unauthorized persons

metadata.detection_notes: Review policies for clear desk (securing physical documents when unattended) and clear screen (locking workstations when away). Absence of documented policies, lack of enforcement, or observation of unattended sensitive materials indicates this deficiency.
